name: Data viz
tagline: Builds a clean, honest chart from a CSV or pasted table, or critiques yours
description: Paste a table or upload a CSV and it picks the form that truly fits the data, then makes the finding itself the headline. Already have a chart you half-distrust? Hand it over and it critiques it with a ranked list of fixes. It re-checks its own numbers, so the result holds up in a meeting.
author: HazeyDataFred
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
